::: {#exr-horse-ride-ring}
You can use this model to gain insight about which policy interventions are helpful or not in stemming the epidemic.

1. Impose border restrictions that reduce the number of initial outside cases that come into the territory. Lax restrictions correspond to a large number of initial cases.

2. Social distancing. The higher the index, the less contact there is between people.

3. Testing for and isolating the infectives. The index controls the extent to which infectives are removed from contact with susceptibles.

Try different settings for the policy parameters to discover which ones are most effective for limiting the outbreak.

:::
 <!-- end of exr-horse-ride-ring -->
